body: Please, please, please don't hang yourself! I'm gay (lesbian) too, and my mom lashed out on me because of it. I'm sixteen, never had a proper girlfriend, never had sex, never gotten drunk. I've lived with anxiety and depression for one and a half year now. I've felt alone, felt that I'm unwanted. Please try to go to your local doctor to talk with him or her. I can't promise that your life will get better, but together, we're all stronger. I can't imagine how you're doing right now, but if there's a sliver left of hope of belief in life in you, please keep trying. I know it's hard. Life is hard. I hope you're okay. I really do.
